deliberateDifferences: Every step and safe cleanup share one absolute caller deadline and cancellation token; no mutation is automatically replayed.

The frozen source attempts IAM rollback after any workspace-create failure. Rust retains the scope after an unknown remote outcome and exposes explicit recovery facts; only a definitely rejected/not-sent create permits cleanup of a newly owned scope.
Rust verifies returned scope/workspace binding identities before further workflow steps and exposes inconsistent receipts as Protocol/Unknown without deleting dependencies.
Generated scope suffix uses unbiased cryptographic random selection rather than the frozen modulo-36 reduction.
ProvisionError exposes structured stage/resource certainty/cleanup/confirmed receipt access while ordinary formatting redacts identifiers and bodies.
Direct workspace clients must explicitly admit an IAM endpoint; the facade shares its configured IAM client.
